author: nicolassalok1
name: flavers
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Static Mesh Gradient style. Default variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 4-color palette (#081C15, #2D6A4F, #95D5B2, #FFF3B0). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
